christians-reading-classics.title: Jack London: An American Classic with Elizabeth Stice
christians-reading-classics.description: Elizabeth Stice, professor of history at Palm Beach Atlantic University, joins to discuss Jack London as an American classic. They explore London's wild life — oyster pirate, hobo, Klondike adventurer — and how it shaped works like Call of the Wild , White Fang , John Barleycorn , and Martin Eden . Stice unpacks the tension between London's socialist sympathies and social Darwinist streak, and why Christians can find genuine value in a writer so openly skeptical of faith.
